ad000: My boss laid me off, and my partner and I had a big fight. After all that, I couldn't stop thinking about having a drink, but I got through it without drinking.
ad001: After my boss laid me off, all I wanted was a drink. I called my sponsor, and she talked me out of it.
ad002: After my boss laid me off, I started craving a drink, even though I was still going to AA meetings every week. When it got bad, I called my sponsor, and I didn't drink.
